_comment: Runnable (system-1) conformance spec for the AUTH-GATED surface — the endpoints every earlier spec explicitly omitted because the runner was cookieless (TECH_DEBT #12; see the omission note in conformance/byo-ai-key.json). Requires a session: run with --auth-signup (bootstraps a throwaway user via POST /api/auth/signup and replays its Set-Cookie on every endpoint marked 'auth': true) or --auth-cookie NAME=VALUE. Only statically-checkable, environment-INDEPENDENT shapes are asserted; VALUES stay env-dependent (e.g. ai-key storage_available is false when AI_KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY is unset — the SHAPE is invariant either way, per AC-18's never-5xx rule). The PUT ai-key probe mutates only the throwaway signup user's own credential row (in-memory by default; one disposable user per run on a persistent store) and asserts the masked-hint shape — never the key/ciphertext (AC-10). Boot: npx nx serve api (uvicorn :8000), or any --url.

endpoints._note: INTERFACE user-accounts §2.6 — 401 anonymous, 200 bag signed-in. Default-created on first read; all three prefs nullable.
byo-ai-key §1.3 masked-hint read — {set,last4,storage_available}, NEVER the key/ciphertext. Fresh throwaway user ⇒ set:false.

byo-ai-key §1.1 — PUT stores (or reports storage-unavailable as 200 set:false, AC-18) and echoes ONLY the masked shape (AC-10). Mutates the throwaway user only. last4 is absent on the storage-unavailable variant ⇒ optional.
positions write gate (ARCHITECTURE §8a; [server-side-gate-enforcement] canon) — 403 anonymous, 200 {authorized:true} with a session. The signed-in 200 arm was previously unverifiable by this tool.
